description: What common Field type and value types does UNION ALL give for each ordered pair among Byte, Integer, Long, Single, Double, Currency and Yes/No (both orders for most pairs; SI row 1 holds the type maxima), for three-arm chains in several orders, and for Integer, Yes/No, Long or Date against Text and Memo (TB row 1)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
